title: Dynamic Physical Hedging amid Jump Losses, Reconstruction-Price Uncertainty, Population Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2608.13745v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study dynamic physical hedging for insurers exposed jointly to catastrophe losses and stochastic reconstruction costs. Surplus evolves as a controlled jump diffusion whose loss amplitude combines marked catastrophe severity, an exogenous mean-reverting cost factor, and endogenous mitigation. We establish well-posedness, moment and stability estimates, and a stopping-time dynamic programming principle, and prove that the value function is the unique viscosity solution of the resulting nonlocal Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation Strategic interaction is introduced through a mean field game (MFG) with reduced-form vulnerability costs, yielding a coupled backward-forward HJB-Kolmogorov system. We establish relaxed equilibrium existence, Markovian realization, and uniqueness under appropriate compactness and monotonicity conditions. Numerical experiments show that reconstruction costs and capitalization materially affect optimal hedgin

translated_title: 动态实物对冲在跳跃损失、重建价格不确定性与群体互动中的应用
translated_abstract: 我们研究了保险公司在同时面临灾难损失和随机重建成本时的动态实物对冲问题。盈余演化过程表现为受控的跳跃扩散，其损失幅度结合了标记的灾难严重性、一个外生的均值回归成本因子和内生的缓解措施。我们建立了问题的适定性、矩和稳定性估计，以及停时动态规划原理，并证明了值函数是所得非局部哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼（HJB）方程的唯一边界粘度解。通过带简化脆弱性成本的均场博弈（MFG）引入战略互动，形成一个耦合的后向-前向HJB-柯尔莫哥洛夫系统。我们在适当的紧性和单调性条件下建立了松弛均衡的存在性、马尔可夫实现和唯一性。数值实验表明，重建成本和资本化水平显著影响最优对冲策略。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合灾难跳跃损失、随机重建成本和群体互动的动态实物对冲模型，并证明了其最优策略的存在性与唯一性，揭示了重建成本对保险对冲决策的关键影响。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a dynamic physical hedging model incorporating catastrophe jump losses, stochastic reconstruction costs, and population interactions, proving the existence and uniqueness of optimal strategies and highlighting the critical impact of reconstruction costs on insurance hedging decisions.
